text.zh_HK: 1963年，九龍。卡式帶一轉，梭聲同木桶聲一齊埋嚟。
text.zh_CN: 1963年，九龙。卡带一转，梭子声和木桶声一起涌来。
text.en: Kowloon, 1963. The cassette turns, and loom-noise and bucket-noise arrive together.

text.zh_HK: 條街企滿等水嘅人，個個手裡都有一隻桶。
text.zh_CN: 街上站满了等水的人，每个人手里都有一只桶。
text.en: The street stands full of people waiting for water, a bucket in every pair of hands.

text.zh_HK: 水喉巷搵麥嬸，聽佢講制水。
text.zh_CN: 水龙头巷找麦婶，听她讲制水。
text.en: Find Aunt Mak in the lane and hear about the rationing.

text.zh_HK: 紗廠門口有個細路仔，聽佢講屋企做嘅工。
text.zh_CN: 纱厂门口有个小孩子，听他讲家里做的工。
text.en: There is a boy at the mill steps; hear what his family does for work.

text.zh_HK: 見陸經理，聽佢講個價係點計。
text.zh_CN: 见陆经理，听他讲这个价是怎么算的。
text.en: Meet Manager Luk and hear how the rate is reckoned.

text.zh_HK: 收工鐘響。阿榮執好兩支筆，跟住阿媽個背影行——兩隻手都比線頭染到白。
text.zh_CN: 收工铃响。阿荣收好两支笔，跟着母亲的背影走——两只手都被线头染得发白。
text.en: The end-of-shift bell rings. Rong gathers his two pencils and follows his mother's back — both hands stained white by thread-ends.

text.zh_HK: 卡式帶一停，你返到2027年。原來一吋水、一毫子線頭，都係屋企嘅本。
text.zh_CN: 卡带一停，你回到2027年。原来一寸水、一毛钱线头，都是这个家的本。
text.en: The cassette stops, and you are back in 2027. An inch of water, ten cents of thread — that was the family's foundation.

_comment: Chapter-3 arc (PLAN §12.1): the cassette door opens 1963 — who the family worked for and what it cost. Water rationing and the mills are the true record (lore file); 阿榮 is the father as a child and must never learn who the player is. Offline fallback lines carry every flag beat.
